summary: Melvil Dewey, inventor of the Dewey Decimal System and co-founder of the American Library Association, built racial and religious bias into library classification, ran an antisemitic club and harassed female colleagues for decades until forced out in 1905-06.

evidence.note: born December 1851 in Adams Center, upstate New York
conceives the decimal classification while working at the Amherst library
how the classification sidelines non-Christian and Black religions and peoples
Columbia library school admits women; applicants asked for photos and looks
argues women librarians should be paid less than men
decades of unwanted touching and kissing of subordinate women
1905 cruise harassment leads to his quiet ouster from the ALA in 1906
Lake Placid Club bars Jews and Black people; land bought to keep Jews out
late-life settlement with a harassed stenographer
death by stroke, then 2019 ALA removal of his name from an award

notes: Part description says John Dewey; the episode is about Melvil Dewey. No role fits a librarian well: scientist-scholar (library science), inventor-engineer (classification, vertical file), business-executive (supply firm, Lake Placid Club) are approximations. Harassment was unwanted touching/kissing, not detailed assault, so no sexual-violence warning. No library theme; education used as closest.
